open_items: Obtain UWM 250 episode records, exact init/seed manifest, checkpoint/normalizer hashes and scorer version before claiming a cluster-aware CI.
Obtain OpenPiVLA 97.4% denominator, trial/seed/init protocol, raw episodes and archive-to-checkpoint lineage before calculating any CI.
Keep OPD box/point/text metrics separate from robot rollout success; metric-specific binary intervals require their own independence and aggregation contract.
If rollout results are monitored adaptively, pre-register a stopping rule or use an always-valid sequential method; do not repeatedly inspect fixed-n CI.
